ACS560-01-088A-4 Ac Drives 
ACS560 is simple to select, easy to commission and use. Its energy-saving easy-to-use features, and environmentally friendly specifications make it an apt solution for wide range of industrial applications. As part of ABBs all-compatible drives portfolio, the ACS560 is designed to offer not only a technically compatible product, but also an all-compatible solution for your workforce, process, business and any environmental goals that you may have. The ACS560 is plug-in ready to control your pumps, fans, mixers and many other variable and basic constant torque applications.ACS560 uses protective coated circuit boards and individual air cooling lanes, all 3 phase current measurement to help ensure highest performance, high reliability and a long lifetime. ACS560 designed to work up to +55 deg C ambient conditions. The ACS560 general purpose drive is compliant with IEC standards. The integrated features such as EMC filters and brake chopper leads to reduction in needed space.ABB ensures that each and every drive produced is tested thoroughly with various test procedures by in-house as well through external certifications. The routine test procedures are stringent and always one step ahead to ensure reliable operation and long life

im-2855151707230.description:
The Allen-Bradley PanelView 800 2711R-T7T is a 7-inch graphic terminal with a touch screen and a variety of communication ports:  

Display: 7-inch LCD TFT with a resolution of 800 x 480 pixels 
Ports: One Ethernet, one RS232, one RS422/485, and one USB port 
Processor: 800 MHz CPU 
Memory: 256 MB 
Power supply: 18–32 VDC 
Dimensions: 197 x 144 x 54 mm 
IP rating: IP65 
Operating temperature: Minimum 0°C 

The PanelView 800 2711R-T7T is compatible with Micro800 controllers and can connect to CompactLogix and Compact GuardLogix controllers. It also offers a variety of features, including: 

Remote monitoring and troubleshooting with a Virtual Network Computing (VNC) server
Landscape and portrait application modes
Stored alarm history of up to 500 records
Recipe capability for uploading and downloading data and parameter settings
Micro800 direct tag referencing and pass-through download 

The PanelView 800 is suitable for a wide range of applications, including food processing, air handling units, material handling, and stretch wrap machines.

Security: The 1756-EN2T provides features for network security, such as user authentication, to ensure that only authorized devices can connect to the system.


Full Integration with ControlLogix Systems: The 1756-EN2T is fully integrated into the Allen-Bradley ControlLogix architecture, allowing easy configuration and diagnostics through Studio 5000 programming software.


Device-Level Ring (DLR) Support: This module supports Device-Level Ring for Ethernet networks, providing automatic recovery in case of network failures, reducing downtime.

Fuji Electric FRN0006E2S-4GB FRENIC-Ace AC Drive / VFD designed for industrial motor speed control applications. This high-performance inverter supports precise motor control, energy saving operation, and stable performance for pumps, conveyors, compressors, fans, packaging machines, and industrial automation systems. Equipped with advanced vector control technology, built-in RS485 Modbus communication, braking transistor, and compact panel mount design for easy installation and reliable operation. Suitable for heavy-duty and continuous industrial applications.
Main Features


Fuji FRENIC-Ace Series VFD


3 Phase 380-480V AC Input


3 HP Normal Duty / 2 HP Heavy Duty


Advanced Vector Control


Built-in RS485 Modbus Communication


Built-in Braking Transistor


Compact IP20 Design


High Starting Torque


Energy Saving Function


Easy Parameter Setting


Suitable for Industrial Automation

MeritVarious interfaces are equipped in a compact body
The stylish design realized with a narrow bezel.The GOT2000 wide models are available in a choice of silver and black.Two Ethernet ports and the built-in sound output interface* equipped as standard add value to your system.* A speaker with built-in amplifier is required separately.
Ultra high resolution display improves expressiveness
Ultra high resolution WXGA screen displays necessary and sufficient information on one screen. Small characters can be displayed clearly.
Add value to your system with sound notification
The built-in sound output interface makes it easy to implement the sound notification system. Not only by displaying the contents of events on the screen but also by notifying with sound, you can convey the necessary information to the operators.
Enable separation of information and control system networks
Two Ethernet ports physically separate the information system network in the office from the control system network at the shop floor. The network architecture becomes safer and more secure by setting different IP addresses for each network.

im-2858979984797.description:
The Omron E3FA-DP12 is a compact, cylindrical diffuse-reflective photoelectric sensor designed for reliable object detection in industrial automation systems.
🔹 Detailed Description
The E3FA-DP12 is part of Omron's E3FA series and is built for non-contact detection of objects using reflected light. It emits a red LED beam, and when an object enters the sensing area, the reflected light is detected and the sensor switches its output. 
It is widely used in continuous industrial processes, where accurate and fast detection is required, such as conveyors, packaging, and assembly lines. 
🔹 Construction & Design


Shape: Cylindrical (M18 threaded body)


Housing material: Durable ABS plastic


Compact size: Easy mounting in tight spaces


Cable type: Pre-wired (typically 2 m cable) 


The rugged design provides high resistance to dust, water, and washdown conditions with IP67/IP69K protection. 
🔹 Working Principle


Uses diffuse reflection method


Sensor emits light → object reflects light → receiver detects it


Output changes based on detection (presence/absence of object)


🔹 Key Technical Description


Sensing distance: Up to 300 mm (depending on target)


Light source: Red LED (~624 nm) 


Output type: PNP (open collector)


Operation modes: Light-ON / Dark-ON selectable


Supply voltage: 10–30 V DC


Response time: ~0.5 ms (high-speed detection) 


🔹 Functional Features


Adjustable sensitivity (single-turn potentiometer)


Visible LED indicators for operation and stability


Protection circuits:


Reverse polarity protection


Short-circuit protection




Stable detection even in harsh industrial environments 


🔹 Typical Applications


Conveyor object detection


Bottle/carton detection


Packaging machines


Assembly automation


Food & beverage industries


🔹 Summary

PNOZ X2.8P Safety Relay is a compact and highly reliable safety monitoring device used in industrial automation systems for protecting machinery and personnel. It is specially designed for monitoring emergency stop (E-STOP) circuits, safety gates, light curtains, and safety switches, ensuring immediate shutdown of equipment during unsafe conditions.
This safety relay features dual-channel input monitoring with fault detection, providing enhanced safety performance and compliance with international safety standards. It offers 3 normally open (NO) safety contacts and 1 normally closed (NC) auxiliary contact, making it suitable for complex safety control applications. 
The relay supports both single-channel and dual-channel operation with automatic or manual reset functionality. Its built-in self-monitoring system ensures that the safety function remains effective even in case of internal faults or component failure.
🔹 Key Features


Suitable for E-stop, safety gate & light curtain monitoring


Dual-channel safety inputs with short circuit detection


3 NO safety outputs + 1 NC auxiliary output


Wide supply voltage: 24–240V AC/DC


Automatic / Manual reset option


LED indication for status monitoring


Compact 22.5 mm DIN rail mounting design

Safety interlocking systems


Material handling equipment

Mounting: DIN rail

Power Consumption: ~2W (DC) / 4.5 VA (AC) 


🔹 Summary
PNOZ X2.8P is a robust and widely used safety relay that ensures reliable machine shutdown and operator safety by continuously monitoring critical safety circuits with high accuracy and fail-safe performance.

Overview;The Simatic S7-300 is used in many applications worldwide and has been proven successful millions of times. The SIMATIC S7-300 universal Controllers saves on installation space and features a modular design.
The CPU 319-3 PN/DP is the fastest S7-300 CPU with a large program memory. It is used in plants containing distributed automation structures in addition to centralized I/O. It is used, for example, as central controller in production lines or as machine controller with high processing speed demands.
Its quantity framework makes it optimally suitable for use of SIMATIC engineering tools, e.g.:

Programming with SCL
Sequence programming with S7-GRAPH

Furthermore, the CPU is an ideal platform for simple software-implemented technological tasks, e.g.:

Motion control with Easy Motion Control
Solving of closed-loop control tasks using STEP 7 blocks or standard/modular PID control runtime software

Enhanced process diagnostics can be achieved by using SIMATIC S7-PDIAG.
As a result of the CPU's integral communications facilities, networked automation solutions are possible without additional components.

With their sophisticated HMI basic functions, SIMATIC HMI Basic Panels 2nd generation are the ideal entry-level series for simple HMI applications. The device series offers panels with 4", 7", 9" and 12" displays, and combined key or touch operation The innovative widescreen displays are high resolution with 64,000 colors. They can be installed in portrait mode and are especially energy-efficient due to their 100% dimmable brightness. The innovative user interface opens up a wide range of operations with improved usability through new controls and graphics. The USB interface allows you to connect a keyboard, mouse and barcode scanner and supports easy archiving of data on a USB stick.

6SL3210-1PE32-5AL0 SINAMICS G120 PM240-2 Power Module
The 6SL3210-1PE32-5AL0 is a high-performance SINAMICS G120 PM240-2 power module designed for demanding industrial applications requiring reliable and efficient motor control. This robust drive module is equipped with a built-in Class A EMC filter and braking chopper, ensuring smooth operation, reduced electrical interference, and improved braking performance.
It supports a wide input voltage range of 3-phase 380–480V AC and delivers high overload capability, making it ideal for heavy-duty operations such as conveyors, pumps, compressors, and material handling systems. The module offers a power rating of up to 132 kW (low overload) and 110 kW (high overload), ensuring flexibility across various industrial applications. (RS Components)

V1000 Drive  Print  1/8 - 25 HP
The V1000 is a world-class compact current vector drive that defines a new world standard. Demands for efficient production and better maintainability are on the rise, spurred by global competition. Yaskawa pays off the promise of being in control with products that make businesses move. The optimum balance of energy input, product output, maintenance risk, and long life is reached with Yaskawa. The V1000 provides a world of power in the palm of your hand! 
The V1000 is the flagship drive of the V1000 Family, which also includes the V1000-4X.
Features
 
 Highlights:

Up to 30% smaller than the competition
Current vector control, open loop
RoHS compliance
On-line tuning
Induction motor (IM) or permanent magnet motor (PM) operation
Function Block Diagram (FBD) programming via DriveWorksEZ™
Side-by-side installation due to patented hybrid heatsink
Removable terminal block with parameter backup function
One-touch copy function with verify
Super-fast 2 ms scan cycle with dual CPU
EN954-1 Safety Cat. 3, Stop Cat. 0
Increased vibration resistance, from 20 Hz to 50 Hz (0.65G)
1 in 10,000 failure rate
Swing PWM function to decrease noise at low carrier frequencies
Pre-maintenance function
Modbus communication
Cooling fan replacement without tools
MTBF: 28 years
Short Circuit Current Rating (SCCR): 30kA rms symmetrical
